note: Eastland County, TX does not appear to zone unincorporated land. The City of Eastland zones its own land and publishes its zoning map only through a 3CI 'FIST' interactive web viewer (Eastland Zoning Interactive Web Map). The viewer page exposes no ArcGIS REST or other queryable endpoint in any form I could read, and searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web found no county or city zoning FeatureServer/MapServer for Eastland County. The city's maps page launches a mapping application behind a javascript link with no service URL. Zoning is therefore not published as a queryable service for the county or its cities.
